searchText: A few of us just published this page today, hope it's helpful to get a lay of the land 🙂 https://ethereum.org/en/community/research/ Disclaimer: it's our first (rough) iteration of this page, so there's a bunch of areas missing. Appreciate feedback & input from the folks in this server! It's all editable on GitHub. ^It's certainly research vs. development focused. If you're looking for dev work I think Tim's advice to check out client repos is a great starting place. Here's more lists of various projects in the space by specific programming languages, might be worth exploring: https://ethereum.org/en/developers/docs/programming-languages/
